## Interfaces

Manifest/Claim support_files (union via frozen_support_files); runner_digest(runner); amendment old_/new_support_hashes and old_/new_runner_digest in canonical_payload/authorize; verdict hashes support at base/head and feeds digests into authorize; aff lint no-assert / aff lint new-skips over find_no_assert / find_new_skips.

## Assumptions

Support paths are explicit (manifest and/or claim), not whole-tree; skips surface as runner not_run (JUnit skipped); lint is separate from verdict (green verdict may still have lint findings).

## Invariants

Unsigned support or runner drift cannot yield verdict pass; support/runner deltas use the same signed amendment chain as oracle hashes; verdict still reads only git blobs; no store tokens under affidavit/.

## Conflicts

none
